title: The weighted open line pieces carry an integer multiplicity triple with explicit carrier, multiplicity and θ·ξ (parent steps 2–3)
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ι : Type) [Fintype ι] (p v : ι → Euclid P) (I : ι → Set ℝ) (c : ι → ℤ), (∀ k, ‖v k‖ = 1) → (∀ k, IsOpen (I k)) → (∀ j k, j ≠ k → (μHE[1] : Measure (Euclid P)) (((fun t : ℝ => p j + t • v j) '' I j) ∩ closure ((fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) '' I k)) = 0) → ∃ R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) 1, R.carrier = (⋃ k, ⋃ (_ : c k ≠ 0), (fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) '' I k) ∧ (∀ x, R.mult x = ∑ k, ((fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) '' I k).indicator (fun _ => (c k).natAbs) x) ∧ ∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) 1), (R.mult x : ℝ) * R.orient x α = ∑ k, ((fun t : ℝ => p k + t • v k) '' I k).indicator (fun _ => (c k : ℝ)) x * α (fun _ => v k)
